# Dev Kumar

> Frontend Developer crafting modern UI/UX and driving growth with digital marketing, creative strategy, and responsive web development.

Dev Kumar is a Frontend Developer and Digital Marketing specialist building high-performance, accessible, and interactive web applications using React, JavaScript, modern CSS, Figma, and data-driven SEO strategies.
